description: This Java class defines a request for retrieving the Link Quality Indicator (LQI) table associated with a Zigbee device, including logic to execute the request and gather relevant LQI data from connected Zigbee devices based on their EUI64 identifier.

classes.name: GetLqiTableRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to retrieve the LQI table of a Zigbee device identified by its EUI64, with logic to gather and respond with the relevant data.

classes.name: LqiData
classes.description: A private helper class that holds EUI64 and LQI value pairs for devices in the LQI table.

methods.name: GetLqiTableRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the request with a request ID and EUI64 identifier.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the request, gathering LQI data from related devices and sending back a response.

methods.name: getEui
methods.description: Returns the EUI64 identifier of the device.

methods.name: getLqi
methods.description: Returns the LQI value for a device.
